name: Venom Fern Extract
summary: Kurzen's stores in Stranglethorn hold Venom Fern Extract, a poison used against Rebel Camp fighters. Sergeant Yohwa needs a sample to help the camp prepare its own remedies.

sections.title: Kurzen's Stores
sections.body: Near the bonfire in Kurzen Compound, supply crates hold Venom Fern Extract. Kurzen's Medicine Men use it to poison Rebel Camp fighters, while Jungle Remedies help heal Kurzen's forces. Sergeant Yohwa seeks both kinds of medicine: the remedies to treat the wounded, and an extract sample to study. The camp hopes to make remedies of its own.

faq.answer: Venom Fern Extract is a poison Kurzen's Medicine Men use against Rebel Camp fighters.

faq.q: Where can I find Venom Fern Extract?
faq.answer: Kurzen stores Venom Fern Extract in supply crates near the bonfire in the center of Kurzen Compound.
Sergeant Yohwa at Rebel Camp wants a sample of Venom Fern Extract to study.

faq.q: Why does Sergeant Yohwa need it?
faq.answer: Sergeant Yohwa hopes the camp can study the extract and make its own remedies.
Kurzen's Medicine Men use Jungle Remedies to heal their forces; Rebel Camp also needs them to treat its wounded.

angles.text: As an Alliance fighter, Rebel Camp's effort matters to the struggle against Kurzen: its healers need remedies to keep their people alive.
